description: Retrievable notes about John's past flips, audience and the local secondhand landscape. Served per creator via the MCP retrieve_creator_memory tool.

documents.title: SGD 4 shirt with a collar stain — sold for 45
documents.notes: Best performer to date. Showing the stain in the first two seconds is what held people. Comments asked repeatedly how he cleaned it.

documents.title: Rail restock — six pieces, three sold
documents.notes: Strong and repeatable. Naming what did not sell drove more trust than the sales did.

documents.title: Wardrobe organisation: folding system
documents.notes: Weak. Dropped off in the first 15 seconds. No follow-up filmed.

documents.title: Haji Lane thrift run, prices on screen
documents.notes: Good. Viewers asked which store the best rail was in — an unanswered content slot.

documents.title: Who actually watches
documents.notes: 20–32, mostly SG, buying secondhand on a budget. They save flips where condition is shown honestly and distrust polished try-on hauls. Strong negative reaction to invented resale valuations.

documents.title: Comment patterns
documents.notes: Two recurring asks: 'how did you get that stain out' and 'which store'. Both are unanswered content slots.

documents.title: Loop Vintage
documents.notes: Best-curated rail on Haji Lane, Instagram is stills only, no fitting-room video. Highest-fit partner.

documents.title: Refresh Laundry Co
documents.notes: Garment care service in Tiong Bahru with no creator content. Would answer John's most common comment directly.

documents.title: What John will not do
documents.notes: No invented resale valuations, no fast-fashion sponsorships, no replicas, no 'flip this for 10x' claims. Budget is SGD 80 a week and he films Mon/Thu/Sat.
